passages.text: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood. The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for building the altar.
You must build the altar from acacia wood.
The altar must be square.
It must be five cubits long.
It must be five cubits wide.
It must be three cubits high.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אֹ֜רֶךְ וְחָמֵ֧שׁ אַמּ֣וֹת רֹ֗חַב רָב֤וּעַ יִהְיֶה֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Make a horn on each of its four corners, so that the horns are of one piece, and overlay it with bronze.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build an altar.
The altar must have four corners.
Make a horn on each corner of the altar.
Form the horns as one piece with the altar.
Cover the altar with bronze.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ תִּהְיֶ֣יןָ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build an altar for Him.
The altar must have special tools.
Make pots for removing ashes.
Make shovels.
Make sprinkling bowls.
Make meat forks.
Make firepans.
Make every tool out of bronze.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ סִּֽירֹתָיו֙ לְדַשְּׁנ֔וֹ וְיָעָיו֙ וּמִזְרְקֹתָ֔יו וּמִזְלְגֹתָ֖יו וּמַחְתֹּתָ֑יו לְכָל־ כֵּלָ֖יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: Construct for it a grate of bronze mesh, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the altar.
The altar needed a grate.
Make the grate from bronze mesh.
The mesh must be strong and durable.
Make four bronze rings for the mesh.
Place one ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ לּוֹ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־ הָרֶ֗שֶׁת אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥ע קְצוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar, so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the altar.
The altar must have a grate made of bronze mesh.
Place the grate under the ledge of the altar.
The mesh must reach halfway up the altar.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ תַּ֛חַת כַּרְכֹּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ מִלְּמָ֑טָּה וְהָיְתָ֣ה הָרֶ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ד חֲצִ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the altar.
Make poles for the altar.
Use acacia wood to make the poles.
Cover the poles with bronze.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ בַדִּים֙ לַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
passages.sermon:
The altar has rings on its sides.
Insert the poles into these rings.
Place the poles on two sides of the altar.
Use the poles to carry the altar.
passages.original: וְהוּבָ֥א אֶת־ בַּדָּ֖יו בַּטַּבָּעֹ֑ת וְהָי֣וּ הַבַּדִּ֗ים עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֛י צַלְעֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בִּשְׂאֵ֥ת אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build an altar.
The altar must be made with boards.
The altar must be hollow inside.
God showed Moses the pattern for the altar on the mountain.
The people must make the altar exactly as God showed Moses.
passages.original: נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתְךָ֛ בָּהָ֖ר כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס

passages.text: You are also to make a courtyard for the tabernacle. On the south side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build a courtyard for the tabernacle.
The courtyard must have a south side.
The south side must have curtains.
The curtains must be made of finely spun linen.
The curtains on the south side must be one hundred cubits long.
There must be twenty posts on the south side.
There must be twenty bronze bases for the posts.
The posts must have silver hooks.
The posts must have silver bands.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֖ת חֲצַ֣ר הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן לִפְאַ֣ת נֶֽגֶב־ תֵּ֠ימָנָה קְלָעִ֨ים לֶחָצֵ֜ר שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר מֵאָ֤ה בָֽאַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ לַפֵּאָ֖ה הָאֶחָֽת׃ וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: Likewise there are to be curtains on the north side, a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle has a courtyard.
The north side of the courtyard must have curtains.
The curtains on the north side must be one hundred cubits long.
There must be twenty posts on the north side.
There must be twenty bronze bases for these posts.
The posts must have silver hooks.
The posts must have silver bands.
passages.original: וְכֵ֨ן לִפְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ בָּאֹ֔רֶךְ קְלָעִ֖ים מֵ֣אָה אֹ֑רֶךְ וְעַמְדּוּ עֶשְׂרִ֗ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֤ם עֶשְׂרִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide, with ten posts and ten bases.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle had a courtyard.
The west side of the courtyard had curtains.
The curtains on the west side were fifty cubits wide.
There were ten posts on the west side.
There were ten bases for the posts on the west side.
passages.original: וְרֹ֤חַב הֶֽחָצֵר֙ לִפְאַת־ יָ֔ם קְלָעִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃

passages.text: The east side of the courtyard, toward the sunrise, is to be fifty cubits wide.
passages.sermon: The courtyard has an east side.\r\nThe east side faces the sunrise.\r\nThe east side is fifty cubits wide.
passages.original: וְרֹ֣חַב הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר לִפְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָ֖חָה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Make the curtains on one side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases, and the curtains on the other side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the courtyard of the Tabernacle.
The courtyard had two sides at the entrance.
One side had curtains that were fifteen cubits long.
This side had three posts.
This side had three bases.
The other side also had curtains that were fifteen cubits long.
This side had three posts.
This side had three bases.
passages.original: וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֛ה קְלָעִ֖ים לַכָּתֵ֑ף עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ וְלַכָּתֵף֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית חְמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה קְלָעִ֑ים עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long, with a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It shall have four posts and four bases.
passages.sermon:
The gate of the courtyard must be twenty cubits long.
A curtain will cover the gate.
The curtain will have blue yarn.
The curtain will have purple yarn.
The curtain will have scarlet yarn.
The curtain will have finely spun linen.
A skilled worker will embroider the curtain.
The gate will have four posts.
The gate will have four bases.
passages.original: וּלְשַׁ֨עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר מָסָ֣ךְ׀ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם עַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַרְבָּעָֽה׃

passages.text: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands, silver hooks, and bronze bases.
passages.sermon:
The courtyard has posts all around it.
Each post has a silver band.
Each post has silver hooks.
Each post has a bronze base.
passages.original: כָּל־ עַמּוּדֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֤ר סָבִיב֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף וָוֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: The entire courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely spun linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.
passages.sermon:
The courtyard is part of the tabernacle.
The courtyard is one hundred cubits long.
The courtyard is fifty cubits wide.
Curtains surround the courtyard.
The curtains are made of finely spun linen.
The curtains are five cubits high.
The bases of the courtyard are made of bronze.
passages.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הֶֽחָצֵר֩ מֵאָ֨ה בָֽאַמָּ֜ה וְרֹ֣חַב׀ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים וְקֹמָ֛ה חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, including all its tent pegs and the tent pegs of the courtyard, shall be made of bronze.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle is God's holy dwelling place among the Israelites.
The tabernacle has many utensils.
People use these utensils for every kind of work in the tabernacle.
The tabernacle also has tent pegs.
The courtyard around the tabernacle has tent pegs too.
All these utensils must be made of bronze.
All the tent pegs must be made of bronze.
passages.original: לְכֹל֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן בְּכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָת֑וֹ וְכָל־ יְתֵדֹתָ֛יו וְכָל־ יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס

passages.text: And you are to command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a command.
Moses must tell the Israelites what to do.
The Israelites must bring oil to Moses.
The oil must be pure.
The oil must come from pressed olives.
The oil is for the lamp.
The lamp must burn all the time.
The lamp must never go out.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה תְּצַוֶּ֣ה׀ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃

passages.text: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the Israelites for the generations to come.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the brother of Moses.
Aaron was a priest.
Aaron had sons.
Aaron and his sons served as priests.
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
God gave the Israelites instructions for worship.
The Tent of Meeting was a special place for worship.
The Tent of Meeting had a veil.
The veil was in front of the Testimony.
The Testimony was a holy object.
Outside the veil, there were lamps.
Aaron and his sons must care for the lamps.
They must do this from evening until morning.
They must do this before the LORD.
God commanded this as a law.
This law is permanent.
This law is for all generations of Israelites.
passages.original: בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֩ מִח֨וּץ לַפָּרֹ֜כֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הָעֵדֻ֗ת יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו מֵעֶ֥רֶב עַד־ בֹּ֖קֶר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹ֣רֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
